EXACT 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 centered separate icons, equal cells and generous transparent gutters, square 1024x1024. No frames, text, labels, scenery or glowing halos. Row 1 forest equipment: crimson leaf one-handed sword, green orc fang one-handed sword, dark leaf leather breastplate, amber thorn talisman. Row 2 undead castle equipment: worn silver grave sword, violet rune one-handed sword, black death knight breastplate, violet skeletal crown talisman. Row 3 ice equipment: icy blue crystal sword, white frostfang one-handed sword, blue plate breastplate, snowflake rune talisman. Readable chunky silhouettes and crisp limited-palette shaded pixel clusters; metal highlights and dark outlines. Every icon isolated on true alpha transparency.
